scope: Bounded read-only validation of newly identified VDensHO1 addresses and related same-window values.
conclusions: 0x8853=0x02 hardware-confirms the source-defined modulating burner type on this WB2A.
0xA403=20.00 C is not a mirror of 0x2544 in this same-window sample because 0x2544 was 0.0 C.
The source groups 0xA403 under LON objects / HCCObjektA1M1 as nviHCC1 FlowSetpt; the current evidence therefore supports treating it as a distinct network/input-side object until further correlation.
0x0A4C all-zero is consistent with E5=0 and the absence of a separate A1 KM-BUS pump; it does not by itself prove an error.
The zero KM error bytes mean no error code was reported at those objects. They must not be used as proof that the corresponding optional participants are installed.
followup: Read neighboring LON/HCC input objects 0xA401, 0xA441, 0xA443 and DHW object 0xA3C0 together with local setpoints to distinguish active values from default/inactive network inputs.
Do not add 0xA403 to production polling until its runtime behavior is characterized.
0x8853 is a good low-frequency/ONCE identity candidate for Home Assistant after documentation review.
